purpose: Allocation record of installable piano kernel releases. tools/build-kernel-deb.py packages a release only when it is listed here with the exact kernel commit and .config of the build, so one release name never covers two different builds.
rule: The release is <kernel version>-piano<ABI>; ABI is CONFIG_LOCALVERSION in arch/arm64/configs/piano-release.config. Take the next integer (never reuse or decrease, never reset on an upstream update) whenever a packaged kernel changes its commit or resulting .config, including DTS-only and toolchain changes: with MODVERSIONS off a module ABI break cannot be detected, so every packaged build is treated as a new ABI. Append the entry after the build; bump upload only to repackage the same build with different package content.
